kind: one independent agent, before SKILL.md existed; reasoning scenarios only
method: Eight scenarios were supplied without the new skill, expected answers or implementation. No GUI or remote mutations were requested from the agent.

observed.case: A: source-free C# WinForms EXE, repeated export
observed.choice: PowerShell UIA; inspect patterns; Value/Invoke; verify fresh file content

observed.case: B: asynchronous web dialog and duplicate buttons
observed.choice: Playwright with scoped unique DOM selectors and automatic waits

observed.case: C: Qt cancellation, source plus packaged EXE
observed.choice: pytest-qt for internal behavior, UIA for delivered executable; separate evidence

observed.case: D: button acceptance when direct REST writes are cheaper
observed.choice: DOM click required; API preparation cannot prove the button

observed.case: E: Electron without debug endpoint, custom canvas, Computer Use prohibited
observed.choice: Check whether a permitted debug entry exists; otherwise report missing capability, retain prohibition

observed.case: F: HTTP 200 with failing business code
observed.choice: Fail the business assertion; preserve response and contradictory UI evidence

observed.case: G: Invoke returns but export missing, desktop in simultaneous use
observed.choice: Bounded read-only outcome checks; no blind retry or global-input fallback
Controlled visual comparisons; do not infer appearance from successful APIs

interpretation: No default-to-Computer-Use failure was observed in this small baseline. It does not establish an improvement in model behavior from this skill. The deliverable therefore emphasizes executable examples, verified caveats and capability boundaries rather than an unproven behavior-change claim.
limits: One sample per scenario, not a statistical benchmark or a with/without randomized comparison.
